module_summary: Two-entry instruction fetch FIFO storing 64-bit fetch pairs with PC and info, presenting two 32-bit instruction slots that pop independently; entry retires when both slots consumed.

anchors.name: push_i
anchors.why: Push request; with accept_o writes entry at wr_ptr_q.

anchors.name: pc_in_i
anchors.why: Fetch PC stored into pc_q per entry.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush resets pointers, count and info entries.

anchors.name: ram_q
anchors.why: Entry array holding 64-bit instruction pair data.

anchors.name: pc_q
anchors.why: Per-entry PC storage driving pc0/pc1 outputs.

anchors.name: valid0_q
anchors.why: Per-entry slot0 valid bits cleared on pop; valid1_q sibling.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer indexing head entry outputs, advances on pop_complete.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count producing accept and valid outputs.

anchors.name: pop_complete_w
anchors.why: Both slots consumed; advances read pointer, decrements count.

anchors.name: push_w
anchors.why: Accepted push enabling entry write and pointer increment.

anchors.name: valid0_o
anchors.why: Slot0 instruction valid output from head entry.

anchors.name: valid1_o
anchors.why: Slot1 instruction valid output from head entry.

groups.name: Entry storage
groups.description: Two entries of data, PC, info and per-slot valid bits.

groups.name: FIFO control
groups.description: Pointers, occupancy and pop/push qualification logic.

groups.name: Push interface
groups.description: Accepts fetch pair with PC, prediction and info.

groups.name: Dual-slot output
groups.description: Presents two instruction slots from head entry.
